risks.title: Exit depends on rezoning that has not happened
risks.message: The only stated exit is sale of the land once it is rezoned to residential. The application gives no evidence that a rezoning application has been lodged, no expected timing, and no fallback if rezoning is refused or delayed beyond the 18-month term. The value of unrezoned vacant land, and so the sale proceeds, may also depend on the rezoning outcome. The credit submission must explain this exit.

risks.title: Existing debt on the property not stated
risks.message: The application does not say whether any debt is already secured on Lot 12 Saddleback Road. For an acquisition this is likely nil, but it should be confirmed with the broker.
